AI agent, Today at 10:02 AM

I understand, if you want the best result it is as much about installation and use as the product itself.

For the ark Tamo Pro, the best setup is:

install it on brick, render, blockwork, or flat stone
use the XL Security Screws & Wall Plugs wherever possible, as they provide a stronger fixing
do not install onto pebble dash
fit it at least 6 inches away from any edge of the wall
use the template provided, not the key safe itself, so brick dust does not get inside the mechanism
if you ever move it, use new fixings and drill new holes rather than reusing the old ones

For opening it correctly:

Turn the OPEN dial anti-clockwise once, a full 360 degrees.
Press down on the CLEAR button and release.
Enter your code, pressing each button firmly until you hear or feel a click.
Turn the OPEN dial clockwise 180 degrees.

For installation help, the step-by-step guide video for ark Tamo Pro is here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4oDKyhXnROU
